summary: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming.
takeaways: We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30.
We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores.
ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines.
